nav.title: Admin
nav.privacyNote: Documents are encrypted, shown only here and deleted after each decision. Every view and action is audited.
nav.label: Admin menu

queue.title: Pending verifications
queue.subtitle: Oldest first. The AI pre-check assists you; you decide.

professionals.title: Professionals
professionals.subtitle: Verified, expired and suspended professionals. Suspending hides them from patients immediately.

bookings.title: Flagged bookings
bookings.subtitle: Upcoming bookings with a professional who was suspended or whose licence expired. Help these patients choose another professional.

suspend.reason: Reason for suspending {name} (kept in the audit record)
suspend.error: Enter a reason, then try again.

review.title: Review verification
review.selfieNote: Compare the selfie with the ID photo yourself unless an identity provider is configured.
review.documentsDeleted: The documents were deleted after the decision. Only the outcome and licence details remain.
review.precheckNote: Assists you only. It reads the documents and compares details; it never approves or rejects anyone.

precheckUnavailable.pending: The pre-check hasn't finished. Review the documents yourself.
precheckUnavailable.not_configured: The AI pre-check isn't set up. Review the documents yourself.
precheckUnavailable.error: The pre-check couldn't run. Review the documents yourself.
precheckUnavailable.refused: The pre-check declined these images. Review them yourself.

review.registry: Check the official licence register (opens in a new tab)

decision.title: Your decision
decision.confirmNote: Confirm the licence details exactly as you verified them.
decision.message: What do you need? (shown to the professional)
decision.messageNote: Don't include ID numbers or other personal details.
decision.deleteNote: The documents are deleted from storage once you decide.
decision.doneDeletePending: Done. The documents will be deleted by the daily cleanup.
decision.invalid: Check the details: the expiry must be in the future and a message is required.

demoData.title: Demo data
demoData.subtitle: Seeded demo accounts and everything linked to them. Real accounts are never listed or removed here.
demoData.modeOn: Demo mode is on: demo helpers such as the UAE PASS test identities are visible.
demoData.modeOff: Demo mode is off: demo helpers are hidden from everyone.
demoData.empty: No demo data. GeneBridge is running with real accounts only.

removeAll.intro: Removes every demo account, its records, its storage files and its sign-in. This can't be undone.
removeAll.title: Remove all demo data?
removeAll.body: Every demo account and everything linked to it will be deleted permanently, including files and sign-ins. Real accounts are not affected. This is recorded in the audit log.
removeAll.label: Type {word} to confirm
removeAll.hint: Type the word in capital letters, exactly as shown.
removeAll.done: Removed {accounts, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}, {rows, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} and {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.
removeAll.error: Something went wrong, and some demo data may remain. Try again; it's safe to repeat.

removeOne.question: Remove {name} and everything linked to it?
removeOne.error: Couldn't remove this account. Try again.

demoData.syntheticNote: Synthetic analytics data for the programme dashboard is separate and isn't removed here. Clear it with npm run clear:synthetic.
